claim: A lead change between two projects in the same mood skips the two-bar breakdown
evidence: cue() set blend: mood !== deck.mood; new test (ascendant -> tablehand, both lofi) failed before the fix. Severity lowered: a deliberate choice, but it contradicts the acceptance criteria and most unconfigured projects share lofi

claim: Turning off a takeover project doesn't stop it; pinning during a takeover waits up to 16 bars
evidence: setProjectOn only set asked for deck.lead; onBar's takeover branch returned early. New test failed before the fix. Severity medium: delays a listener choice by up to ~40 s, nothing lost

claim: A takeover advertised as 16 full bars plays only 14 before its breakdown
evidence: return cued at until-3, blend at until-2; test now expects return at take+16+2 and failed before; browser trace with TAKEOVER_BARS=6 shows 6 full bars, blend, return

claim: A glitch repeating every 128-sample block would be classed as a tone and hidden
evidence: new test (a jump every 128 samples) counted 0 clicks before the fix; periods within 1 sample of a multiple of 128 are now never a tone; recount of all 72 saved clips unchanged (10-3 pops still counted, Far shore pulses 0)

claim: A surge (push from the project playing) isn't reliably full for 8 bars: tiers climb, layers fade in, drums ignore it
evidence: deckClaim only moved surgeUntil; browser: quiet room, push, now tier 2 + accent/tick/drums at 1 from the next bar for 8 bars (fullNow shared with takeovers; drums held while surgeUntil > bar). Verification also caught fullNow faking Far shore's pulse (busy=true); fixed to the real busy state

claim: Turning off the project playing with nobody else working leaves the next worker facing the 32-bar challenge
evidence: Confirmed the 32-bar delay (new test failed before); rejected the 'remove its music at once' part: nobody busy keeps the mood by design (idle can't steal the key). onBar takes isOn; a lead that's off gives way to the next one to work at once

claim: A glitch landing exactly on a same-sign tone edge, no bigger than it, is hidden
evidence: New test (DC step of 0.6x the edge on the edge sample) counted 0 before; the nearest cycle's edge must now be within 0.03 of the step. Low: needs the glitch on the edge's own sample. Recount of 73 saved clips unchanged

claim: A takeover due on the next bar lands before your choice is looked at
evidence: New test failed before. Fixing it exposed the class: a breakdown whose change is called off would stay silent; the page now clears it and glides the tempo back (browser: takeover cancelled mid-breakdown, layers and drums back, 100 bpm, Far shore kept)

claim: A choice made during a lead change's breakdown still lets the stale or disabled project land
evidence: Two new tests failed before: a pin during a breakdown landed the stale lead first; a change to a project turned off still landed. Now any queued change is dropped on your action or when its project is off; an off lead with nobody else working holds still

claim: A claim during a takeover's last full bar overwrites the queued return and chains a takeover
evidence: New test failed before; claims are now refused while a return is queued

claim: Discontinuities under 0.03 landing on a tone edge are hidden
evidence: 0.03 is the detector's own floor for any click: a 0.025 DC step alone on a plain sine counts 0 clicks/min (checked). On an edge it behaves the same as off one, so nothing new is hidden
